I replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging froze when scanning the bill-of-lading (BOL) barcode. Hollis is in #central-team, so they can see that message themselves.

I also warned Hollis not to mix it up with #8841, which has a similar number. Tobias flagged #8841 in #central-random yesterday for a different problem: Door 2 double-booking in the West yard at the Plains depots.
